subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in the Post-Cage Continuum section (PCC-3), opening Braxton's three-fold division of extension: restructuralism, stylism, and extended application of traditional functionalism. (C)ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications): the question is what alternative composite progressionalism implies for the time continuum. ALT-C-PG → T-C-IMP is the main line. ALT-F (alternative functionalism) branches from the main line, and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics), PR-TRS (on a *dashed* line) and (P)RE-ST (the point of idea completion of restructuralism) all branch from ALT-F. RE-ST → INFO-DE-B (information degree basis), which branches to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics); PROJ-DY has a *dashed* line to AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). Structural argument: alternative composite progressionalism, when crossed with time-continuum implications, produces alternative functionalism — and alternative functionalism reaches projectional dynamics only via (P)RE-ST and the information-degree-basis intermediary. The dashed lines to PR-TRS and to AFL-DY each amplify some aspect of the concept they are connected to (alternative functionalism and projectional dynamics respectively).
